{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Southwestern cuisine|Southwestern U.S. cuisine]]

== Ingredients ==
* 4 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breast]] halves, cut into 1 ½ in pieces
* [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|Cornmeal]] as needed
* Freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] juice as needed
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Chipotle BBQ Rub|Chipotle BBQ Rub]]
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep-frying]]
* [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]]

== Procedure ==
#Place cornmeal in a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]] and lemon juice in another pie pan.
#Dip chicken pieces in lemon juice then season with BBQ rub. Dip again in lemon juice.
#[[Cookbook:Dredging|Dredge]] pieces, three at a time, in the cornmeal, then dip in lemon juice again then dredge again in cornmeal.
#Heat oil to 350°F and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] pieces in batches for 6 minutes. Drain on a cooling rack but '''not''' paper towels.
#Sprinkle with black pepper and serve.
